findings.recommendation: M5_shiu for new biological/connectome experiments, subject to owner choice and circuit recertification; preserve M0_current as a labelled engineering/historical comparison
limitations: Only 1-, 2- and 15-neuron fixtures; no whole-brain or full-graph simulation
Does not establish that surround runaway or 0/50 adder outcomes were stimulation artefacts
Periodic phase ensemble, not independent Poisson stimulation
Finite observation windows; recurrence can prevent local firing-rate matching
Amplitude bisection has no global monotonicity guarantee in recurrent circuits
An extra probe-window spike may be a phase shift of existing recurrent activity

review_correction.cause: Freeze-g delivery now discards arrivals for held neurons and neurons spiking on the delivery step; clear-g reset remains after delivery.
review_correction.parent_boundary_test: Both synaptic and external freeze-only cases failed before the fix: ref64 88.3539734661351 mV, Brian2 19.603973466135105 mV (difference 68.75 mV).
review_correction.unchanged_conditions: All 15 non-M2 condition objects compare exactly equal, including every M0 and M5 result; fixture hashes/body IDs and factorial appendix unchanged.
